input: We're running KVM guests on an ARMv8.4 platform with GICv4.1 and observing 80–120 µs vSGI injection latency spikes under a workload that triggers ~50k vSGI/s. The host kernel reports no ITS command queue stalls in /proc/interrupts, and the GICR_VPENDBASER is mapped correctly per GICv4.1 spec. The spikes correlate with vcpu migrations across physical CPUs. What GICv4.1 VPE scheduling interactions — specifically around VMAPP/VMOVP ITS commands and GICR doorbell IRQ handling — should I investigate, and which Linux KVM vGIC tracepoints will confirm whether the latency originates in the ITS command path or the vcpu schedule path?
